fbc-ashdown-ashdown-ar.assessment: Listed in The Gospel Coalition Church Directory — TGC's open self-listing of gospel-believing churches, sponsored by Midwestern Baptist Theological Seminary. Inclusion does NOT imply TGC vetting against the Foundation Documents (Confessional Statement + Theological Vision for Ministry); 52% of listings have no formal network affiliation, and the rest carry Acts 29 / SEND / Harbor / Converge / Redeemer-CTC tags. Treat TGC Directory presence as a discoverability signal, not a doctrinal endorsement — confirm complementarianism + inerrancy independently before publishing.
fbc-ashdown-ashdown-ar.gender_detail: Verify on church website — TGC Directory does NOT require complementarian polity for listing.

fbc-at-the-mall-lakeland-fl.assessment: FBC at the Mall (also known as Church at the Mall) in Lakeland, FL purchased a shopping mall in 1998 for $5.5M and converted it to a worship space. Founding pastor Jay Dennis retired and was succeeded by Aaron Bugner. ECFA accredited for financial transparency. SBC affiliation provides accountability. Unique facility.

score_notes.gender: Male lead pastor (Dr. Kirk Kilpatrick, M.Div/Ph.D., former seminary faculty).
score_notes.cultural: Church Covenant uses traditional fellowship language — 'accept one another...family of God' — no affirming/progressive language detected.
score_notes.denominational: SBC affiliation not displayed on homepage — verify.
